book.name: SAN JUAN
book.title: TZOTIꞌ CꞌUL YET COLBANILE TZꞌIBN̈EBILCANO YU NAJ SAN JUAN

content: Yet ishajlo isbakꞌsat huneꞌ naj yu Comam Jesús
Yet yecꞌ Comam Jesús yin̈ isbel hunel, yilni Comam huneꞌ naj caw maẍticꞌa chu yilni yettaxticꞌa ispitzcꞌahi.
Iskꞌamben ebnaj chicuywi yinta Comam tuꞌ: —Mam cuywawom, ¿tzet yin̈ yuxin mutzꞌan sat huneꞌ naj tiꞌ yet ispitzcꞌa naj? ¿Tom yu ismul ismam naj mato yu ismul naj? ẍi ebnaj tet Comam.
Yalni Comam xin: —Maẍtaj yu ismul ismam naj yeb ismiꞌ naj, maẍtajpaxo yu ismul naj yuxinto hac tuꞌ ye naj. Wal xin Comam Dios caw choche iscꞌul chisyelo yip yin̈ naj, yuxinto hac tuꞌ ye naj.
Caw yilal inwatxꞌenan ismunil Comam an̈eintijan yakꞌ isba tzꞌayical to yucꞌaꞌ chiah akꞌbal yet matxa chu comunlahi.
Yakꞌ isba ay intocꞌojan yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ caw hacaꞌ issajilkꞌinal wehayojan xol sunil anma, ẍi Comam.
Yet lahwi istzotel Comam xin, istzublayo Comam sat txꞌotxꞌ, issomni Comam nichꞌan tzꞌotzꞌew yu iskꞌab, lahwi tuꞌ xin ismasnico Comam yin̈ isbakꞌsat naj mutzꞌan sat tuꞌ.

Yalni Comam tet naj: —Asiꞌ bey haꞌ Siloé, huneꞌ haꞌ etxan, cat xin hatxꞌahnilo hasat, ẍi Comam tet naj. (Siloé chiyal yelapnoj Akꞌbiltij.) Hac tuꞌ xin yu isto naj bey haꞌ Siloé tuꞌ, istxꞌahni naj sat xol haꞌ. Haxa yet ispaxti naj xin, xayu yilni naj.
Yuxin haꞌ anma ayayo yatut iscawilal naj yeb huntekꞌanxa anma ohtan̈e naj, yal hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —¿Cochan haꞌ naj tiꞌ chiecꞌ tzꞌon̈la kꞌano melyu? ẍi anma tuꞌ yin̈ naj.
Ay mac xin halni: —Hoꞌ, haꞌ naj tiꞌ, ẍi anma. Aypaxo mac halni: —Machoj, maẍtaj naj, yaj etza hac tiꞌ jilni naj, ẍipaxoj. Wal naj xin yal naj: —Hoꞌ, hanin-ton-an, ẍi naj.
Yoc anma iskꞌambeno tet naj: —¿Tzet xin mayu ishajlo hasat? ẍi anma.

Yalni naj xin: —Huneꞌ yaꞌ, Jesús isbi, haꞌ yaꞌ somni nichꞌan tzꞌotzꞌew, ismasnico yaꞌ yin̈ insatan. Lahwi tuꞌ xin, yalni yaꞌ wetan: “Asiꞌ bey haꞌ Siloé, cat hatxꞌahnilo hasat xol haꞌ,” ẍi yaꞌ wetan. Hac tuꞌ yu intohan intxꞌahnolojan insattiꞌan; lahwi tuꞌ xin ishajlo insatan, ẍi naj.
Iskꞌamben ebnaj tet naj: —¿Baytuꞌwal xin ay naj tinan̈? ẍi ebnaj. —Caw mach wohtajojan, ẍi naj.
Oc ebnaj fariseo iskꞌambeꞌ tzet caw yu ishajlo sat naj mutzꞌanticꞌa sat
Lahwi tuꞌ xin, yilaxto naj mutzꞌanticꞌa sat tuꞌ tet ebnaj fariseo.
Yet iswatxꞌen Comam nichꞌan tzꞌotzꞌew yun̈e ishajlo sat naj tuꞌ, caw cꞌuxan istzꞌayical xewilal.

Yuxinto ocpaxo ebnaj fariseo tuꞌ iskꞌambeꞌ tet naj hunelxa: —¿Tzet yu ishajlo hasat tiꞌ? ẍi ebnaj tet naj. Istakꞌwi naj: —Yaꞌ Jesús masnico nichꞌan tzꞌotzꞌew yin̈ insatan, lahwi tuꞌ xin intohan intxꞌahnolojan; hac tuꞌ xin yu ishajlo insatan, ẍi naj.

Ay xin ebnaj fariseo halni: —Huneꞌ naj tuꞌ, caw mach yeto Comam Dios ye naj yuto mach chisyije naj istzꞌayical xewilal, ẍi ebnaj yin̈ Comam. Yaj ay ebnaj halnipaxoj: —Yaꞌ Jesús tuꞌ, mach mulumo yaꞌ. Wal xin tato mulum yaꞌ, ¿tom chiyu isyeni yaꞌ hunu cꞌaybalcꞌule hacaꞌ chisye tiꞌ? ẍi ebnaj.

Yocpaxo ebnaj fariseo iskꞌambeno tet naj maẍticꞌa chiyu yilni tuꞌ: —Haxa hach tiꞌ, ¿tzet chawute hawalni yin̈ naj akꞌni hajlo hasat tiꞌ? ẍi ebnaj. Yalni naj hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —Haꞌ huneꞌ chiwute walnihan, to caw ischejab Comam Dios ye yaꞌ, ẍipaxo naj tet ebnaj.

Yaj caw maẍticꞌa yaco ebnaj yahawil con̈ob Israel tuꞌ yin̈ iscꞌul tato hajlo sat huneꞌ naj tuꞌ yu Comam. Haꞌ yute isnani ebnaj to caw cꞌulticꞌa ye sat naj, yuxinto awtelax ismam naj yeb ismiꞌ naj yu ebnaj.
Iskꞌamben ebnaj tet ismam naj yeb ismiꞌ naj hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —¿Ham naj tiꞌ, heyuninal cheyala tato caw maẍticꞌa chu yilni yet ispitzcꞌahi? ¿Tzet yu ishajlo sat naj? ẍi ebnaj.
Istakꞌwi ismam naj yeb ismiꞌ naj: —Caw yeli juninalan̈ naj, caw yelpaxoj maẍticꞌa chiyu yilni naj yet ispitzcꞌa naj.

Yaj caw mach johtajojan̈ tzet yu ishajlo sat naj, yeb xin mach johtapaxojan̈ mac akꞌni hajloho sat naj. ¡Kꞌambewe tet naj yuto ichamxa naj, chiyu yalni naj teyet! ẍi ismam naj yeb ismiꞌ naj tet ebnaj tuꞌ.

Wal xin, hac tuꞌ yute yalni ismam naj yeb ismiꞌ naj yuto caw chixiw tet ebnaj yahawil yehico yin̈ con̈ob Israel, yuto halbil yu ebnaj hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Macn̈eticꞌa chihalni tato haꞌ naj Jesús tiꞌ Cristo, matxa chicochacti yul capilla tiꞌ,” ẍi ebnaj.
Yuxinto hac tuꞌ yute yalni ismam naj yeb ismiꞌ naj: “Kꞌambewe tet naj, ichamxa naj, xayu yalni naj teyet,” ẍi.

Lahwi tuꞌ xin, yawtenpaxti ebnaj naj hajlo sat tuꞌ hunelxa, iskꞌamben ebnaj tet naj: —Caw chabe Comam Dios caw halilo isyelal jetan̈, wal xin caw johtajan̈ ta caw mulum huneꞌ naj chawal tiꞌ, ẍi ebnaj tet naj.

Yalni naj xin: —Hanintiꞌan, caw mach wohtajojan tato mulum yaꞌ maca machoj, yuxin mach chiyu walnihan teyet; hachcachann̈e wohtajan to maẍticꞌa chiyu wilnihan yet yalan̈tocanoj, wal tinan̈ xin xayu wilnihan, ẍi naj tet ebnaj.
Iskꞌamben ebnaj hunelxa: —¿Tzet caw caẍyute naj? ¿Tzet caw yu ishajlo hasat tiꞌ yu naj? ẍi ebnaj.
Yalni naj xin: —Caw mawalan teyet, yaj to caw mach cheyaco yin̈ hecꞌul. ¿Tzet yin̈ xin cheyoche chiwalan teyet hunelxa? ¿Mato cheyoche chexocpaxo cuywo yinta yaꞌ? ẍi naj tet ebnaj.
Yet yalni naj hacaꞌ tuꞌ, istzabnico ebnaj isbahni naj, yalni ebnaj tet naj: —Hach tiꞌ, ayachxaco yinta naj, wal han̈on̈tiꞌan̈ yinta iscuybanil naj Moisés tzujanon̈an̈.
Walon̈tiꞌan̈ caw johtajan̈ tato haꞌ caw Comam Dios anicano cuybanile tet naj Moisés tuꞌ. Wal naj chawal tiꞌ, caw mach johtajojan̈ baytuꞌwal titnaco naj, ẍi ebnaj.
Istakꞌwican̈ naj tet ebnaj xin: —Caw chicꞌay incꞌulan yuto cheyala tato mach heyohtajo bay titnaco yaꞌ, yajaꞌ caw cheyila hajlo insatan yu yaꞌ.
Caw johtaj tato mach chabe Comam Dios tzet chiskꞌan anma mulum, hachcachann̈e anma caw ayco yanma yin̈ Comam, cat yinayo isba tet, hachcachann̈e huntekꞌan anma tuꞌ chakꞌ Comam ispaj tzet chiskꞌanaꞌ.
Wal xin, caw maẍto bay chijabe iskꞌumal tato ay huno mac chiyu yakꞌni hajloho sat hunu anma maẍticꞌa chiyu yilni yettaxticꞌa ispitzcꞌahi.
Tato maẍtaj Comam Dios an̈eti yaꞌ tiꞌ, caw machim nino tzet chiyu iswatxꞌen yaꞌ, ẍi naj tet ebnaj.
Istakꞌwi ebnaj tet naj: —Walach hach tiꞌ, caw mulumach yettaxticꞌa hapitzcꞌahi. ¿Tom chaẍoc con̈hacuyuꞌan̈ hawalni? ẍi ebnaj tet naj, hac tuꞌ yu istennilti ebnaj naj tuꞌ yul capilla.
Anma mach chitxumchalo yu yin̈ tzet chal Comam Jesús

Yabe Comam Jesús tato tenlaxilti naj hajlo sat tuꞌ yul capilla, haxa yet ischahloyo naj yu Comam, yalni Comam tet naj hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —¿Chimhawayto yul hawanma yin̈ Hanin Akꞌbilintijan texol yu Comam Dios? ẍi Comam tet naj.
Iskꞌamben naj tet Comam: —Mamin, ¿mac huneꞌ chawal tuꞌ? Hal wetan cat xin wanico wanmahan yin̈, ẍi naj.
Yalni Comam tet naj: —Caw xahawil yin̈; Hanintonan huneꞌ mac bay lan̈an hatzotel tiꞌ, ẍi Comam tet naj.
Yet yaben naj hacaꞌ tuꞌ, yay jahno naj yin̈ sat Comam, yalni naj: —Caw chiwaco wanmahan tawin̈ Mam, ẍi naj.

Yalni Comam tet naj: —Wal hanintiꞌan, hulnajinan bey yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ yun̈e wilnihan tzettaj chiꞌelico anma, yuto ay anma tiꞌ caw mach chiyu yilni, yaj xin haninan chiwakꞌ hajlohojan sat. Aypaxo anma caw cꞌul yilni, yaj chimutzꞌicano sat wuhan yun̈e matxa chiyu yilni, ẍi Comam.
Ay xin huntekꞌan ebnaj fariseo ayco iscꞌatan̈ Comam, yet yaben ebnaj yin̈ tzet yal Comam tuꞌ, yalni ebnaj: —¿Tom xin haꞌ hunon̈an̈ mach chiyu jilnihan̈ hawalni? ẍi ebnaj.

Istakꞌwi Comam tet ebnaj: —Kꞌinalo tato mach chiyu heyilni tzettaj ye tuꞌ yet Comam Dios yehi, caw machim hemul. Yaj cheyala tato caw chiyu heyilni tzettaj ye tuꞌ yet Comam Dios, yaj mach cheyijepaxoj, yuxinto caw ay hemul, ẍi Comam tet ebnaj.
